source: No rotation period or spin axis of PDS 70 c is measured in the papers this package cites (Keppler et al. 2018, Wang et al. 2021, Benisty et al. 2021, Trevascus et al. 2025). The display axis is the normal of its hosted orbit in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/pds-70-c.json, computed by hostedKeplerElements in @cssearth/astronomy; the meridian is set so that grid longitude 0 faces the Sun and Earth at the scene epoch.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the display axis, the orbit normal; +X is the display meridian; east longitude. No spin is propagated.
qualification: Display convention, not a measurement: the spin axis, spin sense, period and prime meridian of PDS 70 c are unmeasured; the axis shown is its orbit normal.
